analysis.headline: Shares Your Info for Ads
analysis.quote: We may share data about your activities related to PlayStation services, websites, and apps with third parties to provide ads that are more personalized to you on third-party platforms.

analysis.headline: Shares Info with Sony Group
analysis.quote: Sony Group, for purposes related to providing you with content, products, or services, including games, videos, music, software and software applications; community administration or development; to support various business and security processes; research and development; and so that other Sony group companies may contact you about products, services or other offerings that may be of interest to you.

analysis.headline: Records Your Support Calls
analysis.quote: We may also record calls you make to PlayStation Support.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: Your current and recent locations (e.g. on PS Vita)

analysis.headline: Converts Your Voice to Text
analysis.quote: And, to enable accessibility settings functions (for you, or other users), we may convert your voice data to text.

analysis.headline: Monitors Your Online Activity
analysis.quote: However, we reserve the right in our sole discretion to monitor (including through the use of technology that automatically detects images, text, and URLs that breach our Terms of Service) and record your online activity and communication throughout PlayStation Network and to remove and/or delete any content.

analysis.headline: Indexes Your Shared Content
analysis.quote: We may also index and use content which you have shared publicly, as part of our platform’s features like Game Help, PlayStation profiles, or future PlayStation Network services.

analysis.headline: Retains Data on Backup Media
analysis.quote: Even if we delete your information from active databases, the information may remain on backup or archival media as well as other information systems.

analysis.headline: Ignores Do Not Track
analysis.quote: As there are currently no agreed upon standards for the DNT signals or how to respond to them, we adhere to the standards set out in this Privacy Policy.

analysis.headline: No Perfect Security Guarantee
analysis.quote: Although we strive to protect your information, we cannot ensure or warrant the security of such information. There is no such thing as perfect security.
